dns_servers.description: List of upstream DNS server IP addresses to use for resolution (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '8.8.4.4']).

fallback_dns_servers.description: Fallback DNS servers used when no DNS is configured via DHCP or other means.

domains.description: Domain suffixes to append to unqualified hostnames during resolution.

use_llmnr.description: Enable or disable Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR).

use_mdns.description: Enable or disable Multicast DNS (mDNS) for resolving .local domains.

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of responses. Note: requires DNSSEC-capable upstream servers.

dnssec_negative_trust_anchors.description: List of domains for which DNSSEC validation should be disabled (negative trust anchors).

dns_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a DNS query response before retrying.

dns_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for a DNS query before giving up.

tcp_dns_queries.description: Send DNS queries over TCP instead of UDP (useful for bypassing broken UDP infrastructure).

preserve_dns.description: Keep the DNS stub listener socket in place across daemon restarts (prevents client reconnects).

dns_stub_listener_port.description: Port on which systemd-resolved listens for local DNS queries (0 disables stub listener).

caching.description: Enable caching of DNS responses (recommended for performance).

cache_size.description: Maximum number of DNS entries to cache (positive integer, 0 disables caching).

dnssec_cache_max_size.description: Maximum number of DNSSEC-validated resource records to cache (0 = no separate limit).

negative_ttl.description: Time in seconds to cache negative (NXDOMAIN/NOERROR) responses.

trust_anchor_file.description: List of paths to DNSSEC trust anchor files (in BIND format).

read_etc_hosts.description: Whether to resolve hostnames via /etc/hosts before querying DNS.

resolve_unicast_reverse_lookups.description: Enable reverse lookups (PTR) via mDNS (may conflict with nss-mymachines).

dns_stub_listener_addresses.description: List of addresses for the DNS stub listener (defaults to 127.0.0.53 only if empty).
